story.iWant: duplicate content automatically detected and hidden
story.soThat: I don't see the same article/paper/deal multiple times
story.tasks:
Task 1: Create DeduplicationEngine class (AC: 1, 2) - Subtask 1.1: Implement DeduplicationEngine in src/data_quality/deduplication.py - Subtask 1.2: Implement title similarity using difflib.SequenceMatcher (>0.8 ratio) - Subtask 1.3: Implement content hashing using hashlib for full text content - Subtask 1.4: Implement URL matching for exact duplicate detection - Subtask 1.5: Create duplicate_group_id assignment logic
Task 2: Implement quality-based prioritization (AC: 3) - Subtask 2.1: Define source reputation score system (70-100 range) - Subtask 2.2: Implement recency scoring (newer = higher priority) - Subtask 2.3: Implement completeness scoring (more fields = higher quality) - Subtask 2.4: Create quality calculation algorithm combining all factors
Task 3: Integrate with BaseETL framework (AC: 5) - Subtask 3.1: Add deduplication step to BaseETL transform phase - Subtask 3.2: Add is_duplicate flag to base models - Subtask 3.3: Ensure deduplication works across all ETL pipelines - Subtask 3.4: Add deduplication metrics to ETLMetrics
Task 4: Update dashboard components (AC: 4) - Subtask 4.1: Modify tab components to filter out is_duplicate=True items - Subtask 4.2: Add "Show X duplicates" button to UI components - Subtask 4.3: Create duplicate grouping display logic - Subtask 4.4: Update search to work with deduplicated content
Task 5: Create comprehensive tests (AC: 1, 2, 3, 5) - Subtask 5.1: Unit tests for title similarity algorithm - Subtask 5.2: Unit tests for content hashing - Subtask 5.3: Integration tests for ETL deduplication - Subtask 5.4: UI tests for duplicate hiding/showing functionality - Subtask 5.5: Performance tests for large dataset processing

story-context.acceptanceCriteria:
1. Given content is loaded from multiple sources, when the deduplication engine runs, then it identifies duplicates using: title similarity (>80%), content hash, URL matching
2. Given duplicates are identified, when duplicate groups are created, then groups contain original + duplicates with group ID
3. Given duplicate groups exist, when displaying content, then only the highest-quality version is displayed by default
4. Given duplicates are hidden, when I click "Show X duplicates", then all versions are displayed
5. Given ETL processing runs, when content is transformed, then deduplication runs automatically during ETL processing

doc.title: Epic 4: Intelligent Data Quality
doc.snippet: EPIC 4: Intelligent Data Quality - Value: Higher signal-to-noise ratio through smart filtering and deduplication. Story 4.1: Content Deduplication Engine with duplicate detection using title similarity (>80%), content hash, URL matching.

doc.title: Architecture Document - Megalith
doc.snippet: File-based JSON remains primary data layer for data sources. Hybrid Storage: SQLite for users/preferences, file-based JSON for data sources. Preserves existing architecture, fast reads, simple backup, proven at current scale.

artifact.reason: BaseETL.transform() method where deduplication should be integrated. Template method pattern orchestrates extract → transform → load phases.
ETLMetrics class for tracking deduplication performance. Add deduplication-specific metrics like duplicates_found, duplicates_removed.
TimestampedModel to extend with duplicate fields: duplicate_group_id, is_duplicate, quality_score. All data models inherit from this.
Existing deduplication logic using key_field matching, prefer_newer logic. Can be adapted for general content deduplication with similarity scoring.
Pattern for loading JSON data from data/ directory. Dashboard components will need updates to filter is_duplicate=True items.

constraints.constraint: Must integrate with existing BaseETL framework transform phase without disrupting 50+ ETL pipelines
Must use file-based JSON storage patterns, preserve existing data structure
Deduplication must not significantly increase ETL processing time (<30 seconds overhead)
Must work with existing Pydantic models extending TimestampedModel
Must maintain existing dashboard component patterns, add is_duplicate filtering
Follow pytest patterns in Tests/ directory with >80% coverage requirement

interface.name: BaseETL Integration
interface.integration: Add deduplication step in transform method before returning processed data

interface.name: Dashboard Filtering
interface.signature: filter(lambda x: not x.get('is_duplicate', False), data)

tests.standards: Use pytest framework with fixtures and mocks. Follow existing test patterns in Tests/ directory. Aim for >80% test coverage. Include unit tests for algorithms, integration tests for ETL integration, and performance tests for large datasets (>10,000 items).

ideas.test: Test difflib.SequenceMatcher ratio calculation for various title similarities
Test hashlib SHA256 generates consistent hashes for identical content
Test source reputation, recency, and completeness scoring logic
Ensure deduplication integration doesn't break existing ETL pipelines
Test UI components correctly filter is_duplicate=True items
Performance test with 10,000+ items to ensure <30s overhead
